title: Move "Parse state" section under "Tree construction" section
body:
The [13.2 Parsing HTML documents](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/parsing.html#parsing) section is currently structured as follows:

* [13.2.4 Parse state](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/parsing.html#parse-state)
   * [13.2.4.1 The insertion mode](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/parsing.html#the-insertion-mode)
    * [13.2.4.2 The stack of open elements](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/parsing.html#the-stack-of-open-elements)
    * [13.2.4.3 The list of active formatting elements](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/parsing.html#the-list-of-active-formatting-elements)
    * [13.2.4.4 The element pointers](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/parsing.html#the-element-pointers)
    * [13.2.4.5 Other parsing state flags](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/parsing.html#other-parsing-state-flags)
* [13.2.5 Tokenization](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/parsing.html#tokenization)
   * [13.2.5.1 Data state](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/parsing.html#data-state)   
   * 13.2.5.⋮etc.
   * [13.2.5.80 Numeric character reference end state](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/parsing.html#numeric-character-reference-end-state)
* [13.2.6 Tree construction](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/parsing.html#tree-construction)
   * [13.2.6.1 Creating and inserting nodes](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/parsing.html#creating-and-inserting-nodes)
   * etc.

Since the [Parse state](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/parsing.html#parse-state) section exclusively describes state for the tree construction stage, I think it would make sense to move it under [13.2.6 Tree construction](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/parsing.html#tree-construction) as 13.2.6.1.

I find the current section ordering to be quite annoying, especially since the [Tokenization](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/parsing.html#tokenization) section has so many subsections, so that in the table of contents you cannot see the *Parse state* and the *Tree construction* sections at once on the same screen (and clicking on definition links in the Tree construction section often jumps far across the whole Tokenization section). What do you think about this idea?
